messages:
mira: heads-up: created a small docs PR to add the status page permalink + a concise workaround for the outage last night. Need one quick reviewer and a green preview before the customer sync at 17:30.
jay: PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 — edits: add status.redwood.com permalink to /operational/incidents, Known issue note about KV-cache invalidation on autoscaler failover, short ops workaround, and JS/Python retry snippets.
emily: i can do a content pass. FYI the docs preview was flaky earlier; keep an eye on includes.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #523 — error: include file missing: incidents/snippets/status-url.md. See logs.
mira: added the missing snippet and pushed. requesting preview again.
deploy-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-523--docs.redwood.com  please check the render.
emily: looks good. Nit: python snippet uses `retry=3`  prefer explicit backoff + `max_retries`. Also use `timeout_ms` param. Example:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.generate(model="redwood-7b", prompt="...", timeout_ms=90000, max_retries=4, backoff_ms=200)
```
mira: updated snippet accordingly, force-pushed.
sre_miguel: add the detection query we used under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) by (model,region)
```
Also include the status permalink: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-4
mira: added the promql and permalink. Included a short "if you see queued requests" note for Dedicated customers.
support_anna: can you also add a one-line customer-facing blurb so support can copy it into the KB?
mira: added a short blurb under "Customer note": "If you experienced errors during the incident, please check the status link and retry after 2 minutes; contact support if issues persist."
emily: staging smoke? @deploy-bot can you promote?
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #523  status: in-progress.
merge-bot: All approvals present for PR #523. final CI checks running.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #523.
merge-bot: PR #523 merged into main by mira at 1765001560. changelog entry queued.
support_anna: thanks! i'll paste the customer blurb into the KB and notify the support rotation.
mira: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a tiny postmortem and a backport to the internal ops runbook.
